description: This file declares utility functions for RPC (remote procedure call) management within the PyTorch distributed RPC framework. It provides functions for collecting and managing worker names and IDs across distributed peers, as well as synchronizing call counts using a store abstraction.

methods.name: collectNames
methods.description: Gathers a global mapping of worker names to IDs across all RPC peers using the provided store.

methods.name: collectCurrentNames
methods.description: Establishes name-to-ID mapping for the current peer in a dynamic RPC group, adding its info to the store.

methods.name: removeCurrentName
methods.description: Removes the current peer's name from the store in dynamic RPC groups.

methods.name: syncCallCount
methods.description: Synchronizes call counts across RPC peers by waiting for all to join, using the store.
